column1: # What the upstream-drift workflow watches, and the single source of truth for it.
# build/check-upstream.sh reads this; it knows how to query each ecosystem but nothing about which
# components this repository binds. Adding a native SDK means adding a row here.
#   group    reporting group - one GitHub issue per group, titled with this text
#   label    how the component is named inside the issue
#   pin      the MSBuild property in Directory.Build.props holding the pinned version
#   locator  kind-specific: pod name, groupId:artifactId[:packaging][@repo], or owner/repo
#   confirm  download URL template with {version}, or "-" to derive it from the locator
# This repository builds the Catalyst xcframeworks from source (build/BuildXcFrameworks.sh) rather
# than downloading Datadog's, because the binary Datadog publishes has no Catalyst slice. The
# release asset is still the right thing to confirm against: it is cut at the same moment as the
# tag this repository clones, so its presence is the signal that the release is complete.
# Otel is a separate row because it moves on its own line and BumpNativeVersion.sh reads it out of
# the new tag's Cartfile.resolved - a change there is a second decision, not a detail of the first.
